# sra_mongodb_tunnel_jump_list (Data Source)

Fetch a list of MongoDB Tunnel Jump Items. NOTE: PRA only. Requires PRA 26.1.1 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all MongoDB Tunnel Jump Items
data "sra_mongodb_tunnel_jump_list" "all" {}

# Filter by tag
data "sra_mongodb_tunnel_jump_list" "filtered" {
  tag = "Example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Filter by hostname
- `jump_group_id` (Number) Filter by jump_group_id
- `jump_group_type` (String) Filter by jump_group_type
- `jumpoint_id` (Number) Filter by jumpoint_id
- `name` (String) Filter by name
- `tag` (String) Filter by tag

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
